title: Grandfather & Toddler, Backyard Clothesline - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A high-contrast black-and-white deckle-edge snapshot featuring an older man identified as 'Cy' kneeling in a backyard garden while lovingly holding a young toddler named 'Lynn'. The girl wears a light-colored toddler dress with puffed sleeves and a hair bow, illuminated brightly by direct sunlight. Cy is dressed in a utilitarian button-down work shirt. Behind them, drying laundry hangs on an outdoor clothesline amidst deep shadows and garden foliage, depicting everyday mid-century domestic life.
